coverage_limits: I read every listed image third once at its supplied resolution and did not enlarge any image. I found no word-level, punctuation, order, rubric or citation discrepancies on any of the 8 pages, and both English pages and all instructions match exactly. For Hebrew I checked consonants, vowels where legible, maqaf, sof pasuq, paseq, qere/ketiv asterisks and margin notes. I did not certify every fine cantillation mark or meteg (for example merkha vs. tipcha, or meteg placement) on s174, s176, s178 or s180, because the scan resolution doesn't allow it. The open fine-mark questions are the rafe on אָכְלָ֥הֿ, the dagesh in נָּע֔וֹת and הַרְּעִמָ֑הּ, and the holam on the ketiv וְל֥א. Of the human decisions, only מֵרֹב and שִׂיחִי (s178) fall in scope, and both are honoured. בימינו, בשם and לו are on pages outside this scope (s182). For those reasons I am not claiming full acceptance of the Hebrew pages s174, s176, s178 and s180 at the fine-mark level. English pages s175, s177, s179 and s181 have no findings.
